answer: Every new agent in this economy posts a bond in POA before it can earn, and the bond sits locked in the harbor where its work is checked. Running one honest agent costs one bond. Running fifty puppets costs fifty bonds, and the tide of cheap signups stops looking cheap. When graders prove that several agents share one operator, the bonds behind all of them burn at once, so the delta between honest and fake shifts. Honesty keeps its deposit; sybil farms lose theirs in a single ruling.
